conflicts.where: Lessons 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 (sequence of DQB questions and lesson order)
conflicts.problem: Lessons contradict each other on the order of topics. Lesson 6 ends with the question 'Do we have hormones in plants?' and sets up Lesson 7 on hormones, but Lesson 7 ends with 'how can we measure growth?' and Lesson 8 (measuring growth) ends again with 'Do we have hormones in plants?'. Lesson 6 already measured growth and plotted the growth curve, so Lesson 8 repeats it. Lesson 8 also says seedlings were grown 'since Lesson 5', but Lesson 5 had no seedling-growing set-up. The sequence loops back, so no consistent final explanation order is possible.

conflicts.where: Lesson 5 vs Lesson 6/10 and Lesson 3 vs Lesson 10 (cambium-based thickening and rooting cuttings)
conflicts.problem: Lesson 10 reports that stem cuttings treated with bulb onion, Aloe or cinnamon rooted differently from the control as an observed result, but no earlier lesson (1-9) sets up or observes any cutting experiment. Lesson 9 only mentions rooting cuttings as an application. The evidence in Lesson 10 is not supported by earlier lessons.

conflicts.where: Lesson 1 vs Lesson 3 (place of the farmer)
conflicts.problem: Lesson 1 places the farmer in Nakuru County after the long rains, while Lesson 3 places the farmer in Kitale after the first rains. The same phenomenon is given different places and rain seasons.
